channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Creaks
item.description: The ground starts shaking, light bulbs are breaking - and something rather unusual is happening right behind the walls of your very room. Equipped with nothing but wit and courage, you slowly descend into a world inhabited by avian folk and seemingly deadly furniture monsters.

item.title: The Operator
item.description: Welcome to the FDI. As our newest Operator, your role is to use your detective skills to assist our field agents and investigate mysterious crimes. Use cutting-edge FDI software to dig for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth.

item.title: Loco Motive
item.description: There's been a murder aboard the Reuss Express, and you're the suspects! Prove your innocence in this comedy 'point n' click' murder mystery - packed with twists, laughs, and larger-than-life characters!

item.title: World Tree Ranch: Elven Legacy
item.description: You awaken with no memories in a tranquil elven village devoted to worshipping the World Tree. All the elves living here are girls, and they have a unique request—they ask for your help in having children...

item.title: Comic Book Store Simulator
item.description: Manage your very own comic book store! You can unlock over 70+ unique comic licenses, each having 5 volumes for you to sell to your customers! Upgrade your tools, hire staffs, and expand your store so you can have the best comic book store in the world!

item.title: Lured In
item.description: Run your own cozy aquarium! Travel far and wide to catch exotic fish. Put them on display for idle profits, or sell them for instant cash. Unlock research for new upgrades, and ascend for powerful bonuses. Customize your shop, character, and tanks to make your aquarium your own!

item.title: Magical Girl Witch Trials
item.description: Thirteen girls awaken, only to find themselves in a prison. What awaits them: a Witch Trial. Help them prepare for the trial by exploring the prison in order to find the witch hidden amongst them. Find the witch, learn what kind of magic she holds, dispel the lies, and prepare for the execution.

item.title: Monument Valley 3
item.description: Set sail for a world-changing adventure as you guide Noor in their quest through a series of mind-bending illusions and atmospheric puzzles. Can you unlock the secrets of the mysterious world – and the meaning behind the Sacred Light?

item.title: Pax Dei
item.description: Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by the legends of the medieval era. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. Join thousands of players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. What world will you make?

item.title: Starbound
item.description: You’ve fled your home, only to find yourself lost in space with a damaged ship. Your only option is to beam down to the planet below, repair your ship and set off to explore the universe...

item.title: Tavern Legends
item.description: Build and run your own medieval tavern. Cook meals, brew drinks, design every room, hire and manage staff, serve unique guests, handle fights and chaos, and grow from a humble innkeeper into a tavern legend.

item.title: Toy Keeper
item.description: Sort 2,694 toys across a massive three-floor toy store, unlock powerful upgrades, and turn complete chaos into perfect organization in this cozy 3D cleanup game.

item.title: Wildfrost
item.description: Take on the elements in Wildfrost, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder! Journey across a frozen tundra, collecting cards strong enough to banish the eternal winter…

item.title: CD Market - Music Label Sim
item.description: CD Market is a music industry management sim where you build a record label on your own terms, from vinyl to digital. Stay small, or grow into something bigger. Discover artists, shape careers, and survive decades of changing formats, trends, rivals, and crises.

item.title: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
item.description: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

item.title: Desktop Explorer
item.description: Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

item.title: Fogpiercer
item.description: Fight through the fog in this sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where clever positioning, explosive chain-reactions, and the environment itself can make the difference between life and death.

item.title: Jeffrey Eggstein
item.description: Big E’s back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows you’re the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everything’ll turn out great!

item.title: One Deck Dungeon
item.description: The hit roguelike adventure that captures all the fun of a dungeon crawl in a single deck of cards!

item.title: Subway Builder
item.description: Subway Builder is a hyperrealistic transit simulation game. Build a new subway system from the ground up while dealing with real-world constraints and costs. Craft the subway system your city deserves.

item.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
item.description: A narrative-driven hardcore RPG set in a gritty world ruled by real but unrelenting gods. Set out on a challenging lifetime journey, where every choice has a price and entails consequences. Will you become an inquisitor, a judge, or conspire against the old order? Dare to decide!

item.title: War of Rights
item.description: War of Rights is a first person multiplayer game featuring massive 400 player battles with a focus on historical authenticity, teamplay and immersion. It is set during the perilous days of the American Civil War, in the Maryland Campaign of September, 1862.

item.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu – Lost Explorers' Swords Pack
item.description: Enhance your armory with the Lost Explorers' Swords Pack and unlock two exclusive looks before heading out on expedition.
